description: Loads a stored quote by its registrationId (CVR) and short quoteId, recalculates current prices and creates offered, unsigned policies, ready for the customer to review and sign on Plain. Send registrationId, quoteId, the customer's name and email, optional phone, and an idempotencyKey; products and answers do not need to be sent again. Offers are created for products with status.value quoted only. Active insurance is rechecked before creation. Retry a failed request on the same connection with the same idempotency key and body. No insurance is accepted, activated or charged. When state.value is awaiting_verification, ask the person for the emailed code. Creates offers for the selected, authorized existing company without recreating it, or onboards a new company. For an existing company, select it with set_company_context and use its CVR as registrationId; administrator access is required. Always pass the customer's name and email (phone is optional); when signed in, email must match the connected user's account email. Requires signing in with onboarding:write consent; calling it prompts sign-in when needed. Check list_companies first. idempotencyKey is required. If the connected user's email is confirmed, no email code is needed. Do not reuse a retry key across reconnections; obtain a fresh quote after expiry or insurance changes.

inputSchema.description: Creates unsigned offers from a stored quote using its registrationId and short quoteId; public signup also creates the company.

email.description: Email address of the customer signing up; a verification code is sent here. When signed in on MCP, must match the signed-in account's email.

idempotencyKey.description: Random key of 32-128 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Retry a failed request with the same key and body.

name.description: Full name of the customer signing up. Must not contain links or markup.

phone.description: Optional phone number of the customer.

quoteId.description: The short 12-character `quoteId` returned by the quote operation for this company.

region.description: Market. Only Denmark (dk) is supported. Optional; defaults to dk.

registrationId.description: Danish company registration number (CVR), eight digits, e.g. 39488914.

name: create_onboarding

capability.description: Secret proof of this signup. Keep it private and send it with onboardingId.

continuationToken.description: Secret token for /payment-handoff, valid for 15 minutes after verification.

policyIds.description: IDs of the offered policies, once created.

state.description: awaiting_verification: ask the person for the emailed code; email_confirmed: call /verify-email again to finish; verified: offers are ready.

title: Create unsigned insurance offers
